title: Chicago Heights news: Police seek help identifying owner of 'Nickelodeon' jacket found with human remains near Chicago and Elmwood
text:

 Chicago Heights police seek help identifying owner of jacket found with skeletal remains in garbage 
 By ABC7 Chicago Digital Team Tuesday, November 10, 2026 5:11AM 
 Chicago Heights police are asking for help as they try to identify human remains found inside a garbage can on Sunday morning. WLS CHICAGO HEIGHTS, Ill. (WLS) -- Chicago Heights police are asking for help as they try to identify human remains found inside a garbage can on Sunday morning.
 A resident made the discovery near Chicago Road and Elmwood Drive just after 11:45 a.m.
 ABC7 Chicago is now streaming 24/7. Click here to watch 
 Police want to know if anyone recognizes a jacket that was found with skeletal remains.
 They describe it as a "Member's Only, size XXL, unisex Nickelodeon down style jacket."

 Investigators have not yet determined the deceased person's age, race, or gender.
 The Chicago Heights Police Investigations Division and the South Suburban Major Crimes Task Force are investigating.
 Chicago Heights police asked anyone with information to call them at 708-756-6400.
